mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% MoM signals a weakening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST drops > 10% MoM and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% MoM signals labor market weakness, which negatively impacts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% MoM and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals a strengthening supply side, boosting economic growth and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases > 1% MoM and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 2% YoY signals weakening consumer demand, which negatively impacts corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines > 2% YoY and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is negative, it signals a liquidity trap scenario, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 1% and GDPC1 growth < 0% and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs per month signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 jobs per month and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in GDP (GDPC1) is positive and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2% MoM, it signals a robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY > 0% and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% MoM
failure_condition: If GDPC1 YoY > 0% and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% MoM and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.
